import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

n = int(data[0])
ratings = list(map(int, data[1:]))

total_sum = sum(ratings)
max_rating = max(ratings)
if total_sum % n == 0 and max_rating <= total_sum // n:
    print(*[total_sum // n] * n)
else:
    result = [max(max_rating, (total_sum + n - 1) // n)] * n
    remaining_sum = sum(result) - total_sum
    for i in range(n):
        if remaining_sum == 0:
            break
        if result[i] == max_rating:
            continue
        result[i] -= 1
        remaining_sum -= 1
    print(*result)
